title: Game Day #21: The Cursed vs The Cryptids.
excerpt: Wow. Just wow. The Jackets have been on a tear lately, with consistent play, true team spirit, chemistry, and a never-say-die attitude that has them just one place out of the top of the division…
content:
Sounds like a Witcher episode, doesn’t it?

Wow. Just wow. The Jackets have been on a tear lately, with consistent play, true team spirit, chemistry, and a never-say-die attitude that has them just one place out of the top of the division, behind Pittsb—oh, hang on, the arrow thing is pointing upward. 

Lemme fix that.

Poop. 

Never mind. 

I’m gonna point out one thing—CBJ is on a 2-game win streak, and New Jersey Devils are on a (checks notes) 2-game losing streak where superstar goalie Connor Manybucks played (checks notes) 9:03 minutes and made (checks notes) 2 saves on 6 shots before getting yanked in favour of Jake Allen, who finished out the game strong, making (checks notes) 12 saves on 16 shots for a 0.750 save percentage. 

Meanwhile, not in Columbus (because it’s a road trip), Cam Talbot has been backing up Jet Greaves by taking all of the game starts from him. Meanwhile team (Alternate) Captain Zach Werenski has tallied 2-2-4, Knies has scored 2-3-4, and Fantilli has notched up 2-2-4, all in the past two games. 

Hurry up! Plan the parade! The Santa Clause parade, we’re over halfway through November, jeez guys. 

Um… what? 

Santa doesn’t have a parade in Columbus? He just hangs around town for a month, starting yesterday and running up to the 24th of December? 

Doesn’t he know he’s got work to do? 

Also, I’m a tad suspicious that he needs to spend that much time figuring out who’s naughty and who’s nice in this town. It takes him, like, 2 1/2 hours, max, in Saskatoon, and he spends most of that time on a flatbed trailer behind a semi tractor. 

Oh yeah. There’s a game tonight. I should talk about that. 

According to the Daily Let’s Get Everything Wrong About Columbus, the lines are:

I’m not 100% certain, but I think someone is missing there. 

Please, Oh Magic Bones, please 🙏 don’t play Guds in place of Mateychuk again. We survived playing him against Toronto, but the Devils drafted players who are, like, good at the skating thing. The solution to playing a fast team is not to be slower. 

Here’s what our cursed Satanic opponents’ lineup looks like: 

It hardly seems fair that the same team has both a supermodel/power forward and a composer/legendary female F1 driver on the same lineup. But hey, hockey is an inclusive sport now. If you can play, you can play. And sometimes you can play if you can’t play, but you can punch people inna face real good. 

Anyway, the D: 

Here’s the head-to-head comparisons:

It’s weird how close so many of these categories are either almost evenly matched, or in favour of the Jackets. What is separating them from us in the standings? Oh right. Maybe it’s the 1.3 more goals per game that they score. Maybe we should work on that. 

Honestly, this might be good timing for the Jackets to face the Devils tonight. We’re on a mini-heater, fuelled by our top players playing like our top players, and their superstar goalie is hitting a wall after a brilliant start to the season. Missing training camp can be really tough on goalkeepers, so it seems. 

But what do you think?  Let’s get the conversation going. I’ll go put the coffee on.
